planned_reference: Official Sentence Transformers mean pooling (include_prompt=true) and Normalize over text-only EmbeddingGemma2Model

fusion.inputs: BM25 top 50 and embedding top 50; no exact-match override
fusion.tuning: No tuning; fixed before inference; development reported separately from evaluation

terms.interpretation: Retain exact retrieved files and hashes; no automated license acceptance. The upstream model metadata declares Apache-2.0.

model_selection: User explicitly replaced the issue candidate google/embeddinggemma-300m with Apache-2.0 google/embeddinggemma-2 on 2026-10-17 before inference.

runtime.quantization: none; upstream BF16 weights cast to FP32
runtime.export_conversion: none; official safetensors, vision_config=None and audio_config=None
runtime.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean of projected last_hidden_state including prompt and special tokens

truncation: Pilot cap 256 tokens including prefix/special tokens, right truncation; native 8192-token context is not evaluated.
uncertainty_rule: In addition to point thresholds, the qualifying paired gain must have a descriptive 95% lower bound strictly above zero. Otherwise retain BM25.
